name: Joseph
source:
Deviljho True Wyverian. Because of his attitude and reputation, many villagers are too intimidated when they try to approach him.

Despite his stern looks and stoic attitude, he tries his best to get along with everyone, but sometimes he ends up embarrasing himself.
